text:
release-coordinator: Heads-up: we're putting a temporary hold on the APAC rollout for v3.5 routing changes after seeing spike in errors during the ramp. Short freeze while we triage.
deploy-bot: Alert: spike detected on dedicated-gpu-pool-2 (500s and increased retries). Notifying oncall.
mike: I can reproduce locally with long prompt traces. Error looks like `ATTN_OVERFLOW` coming from the optimized attention kernel when sequence >1500.
tara: Can we gate long-seq requests or force fallback kernel? I can push routing caps if needed.
deepak: Applying temporary throttle and per-request seq cap for canary traffic. Commands: `redwood routing throttle apac-v3-5 --rate 0.5` and `redwood runtime set --pool dedicated-gpu-pool-2 --seq-cap 1500`.
sasha: QA will run the reduced-seq smoke set now: `prompts/smoke/longseq_lite.json`. Will report pass/fail in 20m.
mike: I've uploaded kernel logs and trace to REG-512. Tagging eng-runtime for selector review.
tara: If staging hotfix passes, plan is to resume at conservative throttle and monitor per-15m windows. If not, full rollback to v3.4 for APAC.
release-coordinator: Timeline: triage + staging smoke ~45m. If unresolved after 3h we trigger rollback. Avoid non-essential merges to release branches; DM me for exceptions.
deepak: +10m update: throttles applied, staging smoke started. No new 500s so far.
sasha: QA interim: functional ok, perf slightly higher but within acceptable limits on fallback kernel. Will confirm after full run.
